decode_video_from_memory: decode a video from raw bytes using torchvision and return sampled frames with fps metadata
temporal_sampling_frames: sample a fixed number of evenly spaced frames from a tensor between a start and end index
get_start_end_idx_clip: calculate the start and end frame indices for a uniformly sampled video clip given clip index and total clips
decode_selective_video_frames: decode only a specific range of video frames using PTS-based selective decoding to avoid full video decode
probe_video_metadata: probe a raw video tensor to extract fps, duration, timebase, and audio metadata for selective decoding
